analysis:
Examined all supplied source, patches and metadata against the indexed threat model and detailed T-041 evidence. No independently supported regression in this scope. PageCache.swift:19-58 introduces read-only regular-file mappings, best-effort invalidation and residency measurement, with descriptor/mapping cleanup. WeightHasher.swift:250-253 invokes invalidation on the same open descriptor after hashing; digest computation, failure handling and bounded fallback readers remain unchanged. This does not erase secrets or modify the encrypted KV tier, and no changes to T-041 account scoping, cryptography or TTL are shown.
Darkbloom.swift:178-228 changes registration from unconditional hashing to reuse of a matching persisted record only for weightsVerifiedByManagedLoad models. This materially depends on contracts not supplied here: integration must examine VerifiedWeightHashStore identity coverage, record validation/write protections, eligibility assignment and managed-load verification, including how the verified aggregate is bound to the actual served model and SSD cache identity (A-004, T-012, T-027, T-041). Verify mismatch/error paths cannot serve using a stale registration hash. Missing implementations are not proof of a bypass; nil record paths retain full hashing.
StartupPreloader.swift:109-110,197,221 adds a failure-report callback without changing admission, cancellation or self-test retirement. Integration should inspect GLM5NextWiredLimitNotice.report and production wiring to ensure the new diagnostic emits bounded operational text rather than sensitive error data or changes to security controls. Existing fail-open self-tests and detailed log calls are not new issues. No supplied change directly alters authorization, attestation, transport encryption, credentials, billing or fan authority. Remaining material uncertainty is the cached-hash/managed-load contract; unchanged callers and full boundary definitions were not supplied.
